This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:

ORDER This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is under apprehension of his arrest, in connection with Crime No.55/2023, registered at Police Station E.O.W, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of Indian Penal Code and Section 7, 13(1)
(A,B) and 13(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Offence is punishable upto 7 years of imprisonment.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent opposed the application for grant of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Offence under section 409 of IPC is punishable with Life Imp ris o nment.
In these circumstances applicant may not be granted anticipatory bail.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5 .
At this stage, learned counsel for the applicant submitted that no purpose will be served by sending applicant to jail.
He is ready to deposit the loan amount of Rs.3 Lakhs under protest.
Said amount be kept in FDR.

6. Considering the totality of facts and circumstances of the case and allegations made against the applicant, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed on condition that applicant shall deposit an amount of Rs.3,00,000/- (Rs.Three Lakhs) before Central Bank of India from which loan has been obtained and shall file receipt before the Investigating Officer.
7.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, he be released on bail on his furnishing receipt of deposit of an amount of Rs.3,00,000/- (Rs. Three Lakhs) and on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lakh only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.
(e) He shall regularly attend the trial and will not seek unnecessary adjournment.

9. Applicant will further abide by the condition enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
